title: A writing checker
oneLine: Spelling, grammar and tone suggestions as you type.
why: A local language model reads your text and suggests fixes. One person cancelled Grammarly this way and wrote it up; the catch is it needs a decent GPU or a paid model API, so the saving is real only if you already have one.
tool: Claude Code or Gemini CLI to build it; a local model via LM Studio to run it
keep: Browser-extension polish, the 'works everywhere' feeling, the team features.
breaks: Model updates change the suggestions. Browser extensions need re-signing when the browser updates.

sources.label: How-To Geek: cancelled hundreds in yearly subscriptions by vibe-coding alternatives
